bounded_changes: Free runner-local X25519 envelope handoff for credentials and network context; private recipient key is never uploaded.
Redacted cloud evidence mode for QR, pass-token, credentials, DOM text, and failure diagnostics.
Per-run nested artifact manifest layout compatible with the deterministic ten-run reducer.
Privacy six-surface safe-projection audit explicitly marked source-only and safe offline security scenario matrix.
One commit-pinned native build remains the only native build in each cloud workflow run; no local Xcode build was performed.
Baguette uses the official scroll envelope for off-screen controls and the harness does not send hardware Escape events.
The native flow validates the signed token by reading the clipboard rather than depending on a transient accessibility acknowledgement.

prior_remote_validation.failure: Hosted iOS backboardd respawn interrupted the accessibility/input connection and RunningBoard terminated FacePassGate while waiting for Provision this gate; the native report preserved SpringBoard Home and no app crash stack.

remote_validation.reason: A narrow clipboard assertion fix was pushed after the prior validation failure. The published baseline is not a safe fallback because its uploaded context.json contains ephemeral credentials and provisioning material.

claim_boundary: The prior candidate validation failed before native provisioning because of hosted simulator lifecycle instability. The new candidate retains the safe encrypted handoff and adds a clipboard-based signed-token assertion; it must complete one remote validation before any target batch. The published baseline is excluded from evidence because its artifact contract is not privacy-safe.
